changelog: The SMS provider, account, secret and sender are saved in the account Creative Branding's plugins share (creativebranding_sms), so a shop running Creative Restock too fills them in once; the Text messages settings say so. Which texts go, the checkout box and the opt-out line stay Tracking's own settings.

On update, the provider settings move to the shared account by themselves, unless Creative Restock already set one up there; the old settings are kept, so going back to 1.10.1 still sends. Uninstalling lets go of the shared account and deletes it only when no other plugin uses it.

The provider code is the shared creativebranding/sms package, bundled in src/Vendor/Sms (copied by tools/sms-sync.sh). The ctracking_sms_gateway filter now takes the package's SmsGateway, whose send() has a third parameter (a template's values) and whose results also carry provider, code and reason.
Reasons a text wasn't sent are still shown in the shop's language, with the same wording.
Texts count as set up only when the shared account can send them (Account::ready()): a sender is needed except with ClickSend. Before, an account without one counted as set up and every text failed.
CTRACKING_SMS_TOKEN takes the place of the secret for Tracking only; the settings field says so.

CreativeBranding\Tracking\Sms\SmsGateway, the 1.10 interface for the ctracking_sms_gateway filter. A gateway built on it still sends: it is wrapped in Sms\LegacyGateway. Implement CreativeBranding\Tracking\Vendor\Sms\SmsGateway instead.

Updating from 1.10 when Creative Restock had set up WhatsApp only on the shared account (no SMS sender): with the same provider and account, Tracking's sender is added to it, so texts keep going; with a different account it is left alone and texts wait for a sender instead of failing.
ctracking_version is never lowered when an older version runs.
